formulaBlock.normalization: Packet list used as normalized; normalized one-based positions.

cleansingStrength.rationale: C6: no strong anionic. Earliest cleansing surfactant Sodium Cocoyl Isethionate (2, mild anionic) with prominent amphoterics Lauramidopropyl Betaine (3) and Cocamidopropyl Betaine (4); Sodium Lauroyl Sarcosinate (5) is a further mild anionic -> low.
cleansingStrength.counterSignals: Three-to-four surfactants in a sulfate-free system give a complete foaming cleanse; convention keeps low.

conditioningLevel.rationale: Cleansing-led architecture: the only conditioning agent is Polyquaternium-10 (11), listed after Parfum and preservatives; Glycerin (24) and Cocos Nucifera Fruit Juice (25) are trace.
conditioningLevel.counterSignals: Polyquaternium-10 is a meaningful conditioning polymer and isethionate leaves a soft feel; moderate is a realistic neighbor.

weightPotential.rationale: A single late cationic polymer, no reinforcing route.

persistence.rationale: Low level; PQ-10 can build up with repeated use, but alone and late.

resetCapacity.rationale: Mild isethionate/sarcosinate/betaine chassis (C6 low) with nothing heavy to offset; between weak and moderate.

excluded: Citrus Aurantium Peel Oil (17) and fragrance materials: fragrance (6.4)
weightPotential.whyNotNeighborBand: Single deposition family without a reinforcing route; the polymer is after preservatives (trace). A mild chassis gives limited reset, which is the reason confidence is moderate rather than high.
weightPotential.confidenceLimitingFactor: PQ-10 buildup potential with a mild chassis; step toward moderate realistic.

focusPrimary.rationale: Formula-only: mild sulfate-free cleansing with little care; no specialist route.

usageRole.rationale: Default; frequent with explicit frequency wording.

scalpComfortTarget.rationale: CSA not met: no E4 comfort or humectant route in positions 1-7 (Glycerin 24 late).
